content: YouTube API Services Developer Policies (verified 2026-06-24): API Clients must not modify, interfere with, replace, or block advertisements (III.I.5), must not modify/interfere with any YouTube player functionality (III.I.6), must not use any technology other than YouTube API Services to access API Data (III.I.14), must not recreate YouTube core user experiences without significant independent value (III.I.1), search results must not be modified or merged (III.C.5), background players prohibited (III.I.9), must display YouTube branding/attribution for YouTube content (III.F.2). API Clients must link YouTube ToS and require privacy policy acceptance (III.A.1-2). App Review 5.2.2-5.2.3 mirrors this: apps displaying third-party content need service permission; streaming that violates ToS is rejectable.
